segments.an5.165:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi … pe …“yo hi koci, āvuso, paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, sabbo so pañcahi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
segments.an5.165:1.3: Mandattā momūhattā [momuhattā (sī.)] paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāpiccho icchāpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātukāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, atha vā panevaṃcitto [atha vā pakuppanto (sī. pī.)] paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati –
segments.an5.165:1.4: ‘sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce [no ca (syā.)] me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati ahamassa sammadeva byākarissāmī’ti.
segments.an5.165:1.5: Yo hi koci, āvuso, paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, sabbo so imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
segments.an5.165:1.6: Ahaṃ kho panāvuso, evaṃcitto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchāmi –
segments.an5.165:1.7: ‘sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati, ahamassa sammadeva byākarissāmī”ti.

lines: Pañcame paribhavanti paribhavanto, evaṃ paribhavissāmīti paribhavanatthāya pucchatīti attho.
